data.name: Dragonero
data.detailed_description:
Five Unique Heroes

Guide the heroes of Dragonero in this epic adventure: Ian, Gmor, Myrva, Alben and Sera. Join the legends in the fight to save Erondàr.

Tackle the story of each of the characters before bringing them all together in the main adventure: make your way through the intrigue and dangers that make up the rich and engaging story of the Dragonero universe.

Turn-based combat

Experience the excitement of turn-based combat as in the great role-playing game classics. Choose your skills wisely, use unique items, and coordinate your moves to defeat fearsome opponents. Victory depends on your strategy and planning.

Dungeons and battles

Face evil in the form of Draquir, a powerful new threat. As darkness spreads across Erondàr, the fate of the world lies in your hands. Prepare to face breathtaking trials in over ten different settings that will delight any explorer.

A vast openworld: the Erondár

Immerse yourself in a vast and mysterious world, exploring unknown lands and both procedurally generated and hand-created dungeons. Each adventure is unique, with new challenges and treasures to discover with each journey.

Rest and do not succumb to fatigue

Battles and exploration will fatigue Heroes; manage rests and use items to invigorate them. Face an ever-increasing challenge as you venture deeper into Erondàr.

Get ready for a gaming experience that will enchant Dragonero fans and capture the souls of classic RPG lovers. The fate of Erondàr is in your hands - will you be the hero the world needs?

data.short_description: Dragonero is a classic turn-based RPG with a strategic twist that will challenge you: explore dungeons, plan journeys in a open world filled with events, and face dozens of enemies in turn-based combat. Follow the different champion's paths in this vast comic book-style fantasy universe.
